notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Adjustment of the multiplier setting for the relic copy
No requirements (1 times), reputation level 5 (3 times), reputation level 8 (5 times), reputation level 10 (10 times)
In addition, fixed the BUG where the tickets for the three difficulty levels of Mythological Desert were inconsistent (they should all have three tickets at 1x).
Since this update has added a 10-fold ratio, it is no longer appropriate to roughly multiply the result by 10. Instead, multiple randomizations should be conducted
2. The barbarian invasion has been adjusted to a free team formation for a 5-player dungeon
3. Dimensional Land has added a "Best Historical Record" feature, which records the best number of kills in one hour and enables a one-hour sweep function
(Simulate kills based on historical records)

notes.title: 2024/3/18 Update announcement
notes.content:
Update announcement:
1. Reset 330 hero skins (those purchased will be returned to skin rolls for re-selection)
2. Added new military technology
3. Added T6 soldiers
4. After recruiting heroes 1,000 times in the tavern, you will definitely get a custom hero
(Previous data will be synchronized)
5. Exclusive weapon upgrade adds ruby to increase success rate operation
6. Cancel the limit on the number of donations to the alliance warehouse, and add the operation of clearing the alliance warehouse
7. Change the global high-quality network route (connecting to the server is smoother)

notes.title: 2024/3/15 Update announcement:
notes.content:
Update announcement:
1. After the update, there will no longer be alliance personal points.
2. After the update, the amount of donations to the alliance warehouse is no longer limited (only alliance points will be added, not personal points)
3. Cancel the alliance store function
4. Personal points in alliance gifts are converted into alliance points
5. Renew all existing skins (all purchased skins will be refunded and reselected)
6. The tavern has added 1,000 draws to get a custom hero gift box (the data of previous draw cards is synchronized)
7. Special weapon upgrade adds ruby to increase the success rate by 8%.
8. New Add T6 Solider
9. Change the high-quality network route (the server connection is smoother)

notes.title: 8.6.0 Update
notes.content:
1. Added "Main Line Level" gameplay
2. Adjust hero balance in all aspects
3. Added benefits for returning old players (offline for more than 1 month)
4. New player sign-in extended to 14 days
5. Each failure in skill awakening increases the probability of success by 1%.
6. Added custom skill stone fragments (dropped from ruins)
7. After this update, the advanced heroes will record the materials used. When resetting, press the materials used to return them.
8. New exclusive props for the summoning of divine soldiers

8.4 version update

3. New exclusive weapon system (strengthening talent skills)
4. New skill awakening system (strengthening decomposition skills)
5. Added weekly time-limited relics of the Gate of Dimensions (drops exclusive and skill awakening related props)
